subject: C-suite champion lane + EB takt: aligning MAP and close dates

Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 15:05:00 -0400
Subject: C-suite champion lane + MAP alignment for Acme close

Hi Logan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. We have internal momentum and Procurement asked us to surface a clear MAP, an evaluation cadence, and the expected EB (executive briefing) timing so they can align budgets for FY28.

What we need from Redwood:
- A simple exec-sponsor mapping (who on Redwood will be the C-level champion for Acme?)
- A proposed EB agenda and 60/30/15 cadence for the evaluation team (we're doing a technical eval + procurement review)
- Clear close timeline with target contract signature date (our finance org needs this to justify the Q3 spend)

I've attached our internal target timeline and a short requirements doc. Preferred EB windows: week of Jul 19 (US mornings) or Jul 26 (EMEA-friendly).

Can you confirm sponsors and propose 2x slots? Also sharing a quick HubSpot link to the deal for reference.

Thanks,
Alice Becker
Director of Data Platforms
DataForge

Alice — appreciate the clarity. Quick plan from our side:

1) Exec sponsor (C-suite champion): Laura Bennett (VP, Commercial) will be the outward-facing exec for Acme. She will own the EB-level relationship and close approvals.
2) EB agenda: I've attached a draft (60-min) that maps to your eval phases — tech deep dive, cost/ops Q&A, procurement checklist, exec alignment.
3) Timeline: Let's target a signature by 2027-08-02 to hit your FY28 planning; that gives us a two-week post-EB remediation window.

Proposed EB slots (pick two):
- Tue, 20 Jul 2027, 10:00 AM ET
- Wed, 21 Jul 2027, 03:00 PM ET

Marissa / Karthik / Priyom, can each own these? Suggested roles: Marissa — lead exec outreach & prep; Karthik — evaluation plan owner (technical coordination); Priyom — procurement/contract sequencing and SOW coordination.

Links: MAP (draft) and HubSpot deal included below. I'll follow up with a DocuSign for the SOW once we lock the EB.

—Logan Wright
